title: Floating toolbar: paired FAB
purpose: Check a floating toolbar paired with an independently clickable floating action button, including logical placement in RTL.
changes: Added a paired 56 dp FAB with an 8 dp gap and start/end placement for horizontal and vertical floating toolbars.
steps: Find Floating toolbar with FAB near the top. A separate square-rounded plus button should sit beside the toolbar with a small gap.
Tap the plus button; the status should say Create selected. Tap a toolbar action and check that its name is reported.
Turn on FAB at start; the plus button moves to the other end of the toolbar. Turn on RTL and check that logical start/end positions reverse.
Choose OK if placement and clicks work, or Reject with what happened and your device.
expected: The FAB and toolbar actions work independently, keep an 8 dp gap and follow start/end and RTL placement.
limits: This page exercises horizontal placement with the regular 56 dp FAB. Vertical geometry has automated tests; other FAB sizes, compact collapse, exact colors, elevation and Android device visual parity remain open.
validation: Rust tests check horizontal start/end and RTL, vertical top/bottom and FAB activation; a 320 by 440 browser test checks FAB and toolbar clicks, start/end and RTL placement.
